dog.description_text: Meet Astrid! Astrid is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Her foster says "Once we took Astrid home and let her acclimate to the apartment in a small room she immediately started asking for affection and playtime. She got more and more comfortable over time, and after 3 weeks, started to enjoy cuddles. She's a kitty who likes to know what activity you're doing and join in. She is so affectionate and always wants to play. She can be both energetic and calm and really likes being in the room while you're doing anything. When she's playing by herself, she likes to take the feather on a string toy and drape it over the horizontal support at the bottom of the chair legs and play with the toy upside down and do flips all over the chair. Once she has defeated the toy she carries it around the apartment showing it off." She is a very sweet and fun companion. If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Astrid! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Check back for updates—or stop by to say hello and discover who Astrid is becoming.
dog.name: Astrid
